title: Fed's Goolsbee calls inflation report 'borderline disturbing' as central bank weighs more hikes
summary: In a recent report, the consumer price index exhibited a greater-than-anticipated increase in October, prompting concern among Federal Reserve officials. Federal Reserve member Goolsbee described the inflation data as 'borderline disturbing,' indicating potential implications for future interest rate hikes. This unexpected rise in inflation may compel the central bank to reassess its monetary policy strategies moving forward.
